name: csproj-reader-unconditional-static-subset
body: ProjectFileReader.Read evaluates no MSBuild conditions: a property or item under a Condition attribute or inside Choose/When/Otherwise is skipped, so a .NET Framework-style project whose DEBUG/TRACE DefineConstants sit only in Configuration-conditioned groups yields no preprocessor symbols, and framework-conditioned PackageReferences are dropped. It also derives no target framework from a .NET Framework-style TargetFrameworkVersion (v4.7.2 → net472), and ignores Compile Exclude/Update and Imported files such as Directory.Build.props. Its Razor globbing ignores EnableDefaultItems and EnableDefaultContentItems=false, so an SDK-style project that disables default content items still gets **/*.cshtml and **/*.razor, and a Content/None Include or Remove naming a non-Razor file is filtered out by extension silently. Upgrade when symbols or references from conditioned groups must reach the compilation, when reference resolution needs the target framework of a net4x project, or when projects that disable default content items appear.
